name: Syntara Limited
summary: Syntara Limited is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, headquartered in Frenchs Forest, Australia, developing therapies that target extracellular matrix dysfunction using amine oxidase chemistry. Its research focuses on blood cancers and inflammatory and fibrotic disorders, and its lead compound, amsulostat, is in Phase 1c/2 trials for myelofibrosis and is also being evaluated for myelodysplastic syndrome.
